adjudication.rationale: In `TopicEmbed.import_remote`, it calls `open(url).read` (app/models/topic_embed.rb) but that file does not `require 'open-uri'`. The only added `require 'open-uri'` in this diff is in `Jobs::PollFeed` (app/jobs/scheduled/poll_feed.rb), so `import_remote` can be invoked (e.g., via `TopicRetriever#fetch_http` or `disqus.thor`) before `poll_feed.rb` is loaded, making URL-opening via `open` fail unless some other non-shown code happened to require open-uri. This is an implicit load-order coupling introduced by the diff.
